Naturale Cherng Talay

Villa in Cherng Talay
HomePhuket PropertyVillas for SaleNaturale Cherng Talay

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Phase 1 of a small gated enclave of single-storey saltwater-pool villas on Soi Cherng Talay 1, built by AAG Development. Villas come in 3 and 4 bedroom layouts of roughly 357 to 511 sqm built-up on plots of 423 to 693 sqm. The 4BR plan has two master suites and a 4.5 m living-room ceiling.

Facilities & amenities

  • 24/7 security and monitoring
  • CCTV
  • Covered parking
  • Landscaped gardens
  • Private saltwater swimming pool
  • Jacuzzi
  • Sun lounges
